input.short_description: Create and list transform steps that modify events in a pipeline via the v2 REST API.
input.body:
Transforms endpoint {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=primary}}

Create and manage transform steps that modify and filter events as they flow through a pipeline. Base URL: https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2.

Create a transform step

POST /v2/transforms

{{ds:component/parameter-table|rows_html=pipeline_idstringYesID of the pipeline this transform belongs to.namestringYesHuman-readable transform name, unique within the pipeline.typestringYesTransform type: filter, map, aggregate, or custom.configobjectYesType-specific configuration object defining the transform logic.positionintegerNoOrder in the pipeline's transform chain (0-indexed). Defaults to append at end.}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-transform.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/transforms \\\n -H \"Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY\" \\\n -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n -d '{\n \"pipeline_id\": \"pipe_orders_warehouse\",\n \"name\": \"filter-high-value\",\n \"type\": \"filter\",\n \"config\": { \"expression\": \"event.amount > 100\" }\n }'}}

List transforms

GET /v2/transforms?pipeline_id={id} — returns all transform steps for a given pipeline, cursor-paginated. See Rate limits & errors for the pagination envelope.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=list-transforms.sh|language=bash|code=curl https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/transforms?pipeline_id=pipe_orders_warehouse \\\n -H \"Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY\"}}

Transform types

Each transform type requires its own config shape:

  • filter — Boolean expression that drops events failing the condition.
  • map — Field-level transformations: rename, cast, compute derived values.
  • aggregate — Windowed rollups by time or key boundaries.
  • custom — JavaScript-like expressions for complex logic.
{{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Transform order matters|body_html=

Transforms are executed in the order they appear in the pipeline. Position matters for performance and correctness: place filters early to reduce downstream work, and aggregates before maps when possible.

}} {{ds:component/docs-toc|items_html=
  • Create a transform step
  • List transforms
  • Transform types
    • }}
